title: Harden the PASSAGE V6 authoring-to-release path without activation
purpose: Create and qualify a single bounded Git candidate that makes the exact historical learnit.kit.v6 schema and validator reachable through a fail-closed V6 FactoryRun and qualified-release path, while preserving V1 bytes internally, excluding constructed from new V6 production, enforcing independent V6 semantic/source/visual review, and binding release evidence to the exact qualified pull-request head.
invariants: The exact historical learnit.kit.v6 schema Git blob remains 0b61612ce711a5a6bd0e278385204188f130818b.
The exact historical V6 validator Git blob remains 1650d550810c50b5fdf64d14cbff42c9c94c4202.

The historical V1 reliability and release-set implementations are preserved byte-identically as internal modules with blobs 285c037b5e430ca2f75d61583d9d22c23073f7f7 and 10be3727243e8dc66d10c1a11731c7f61ed2c8e8.
V1 and V6 dispatch is explicit and closed; no implicit upgrade, downgrade, or fallback is admitted.
New V6 production excludes constructed with exact reason ACTIVITY_TYPE_DISABLED:constructed while retaining schema readability for historical V6 bytes.
Productive activities are admitted only through the exact V6 validator and an explicit productiveCorrectness semantic-review check.
Role B is exact-byte authorized source truth; Role A is supplemental and cannot be hidden source truth.
A declared material visual requirement cannot pass with a text-only kit and must receive visualAdequacy=pass against embedded media.
Every V6 FactoryRun and qualified release embeds the exact implementation commit and immutable schema/validator identities.
This work package does not merge, activate PASSAGE, edit OneDrive selectors, publish a durable activation pointer, or mutate learner runtime.
requiredEvidence: Exact base 4d3fb54456bb6a832adecf08938eb2d942b3f4fb and exact allowed-path diff only.
Repository governance PASS on the exact pull-request head.
PR scope / gate PASS for ATLAS-WP-064.
PASSAGE V6 / exact-head gate PASS on the exact pull-request head.
Exact Git blob checks for historical V6 schema/validator, V4/V5 compatibility sources, and wrapped V1 implementations.
Positive end-to-end proof from V6 kit through FactoryRun to verified qualified release bound to pull_request.head.sha.
Negative/adversarial proof for constructed, V6 validation constraints, semantic/source separation, visual rule, and cross-version release rejection.
adversarialTests: Reject constructed in the first course and in a later course with ACTIVITY_TYPE_DISABLED:constructed.
Reject V6 validation activities that target more than one objective.
Reject productive evaluator kinds that do not match the productive part responseKind.
Reject validationSlot on a non-validation activity.
Reject productive activities without deterministic scoring.
Hold when the independent review flags hint answer leakage.
Hold when Role A is used as hidden source truth and fail closed on invalid Role B claim mapping.
Hold a text-only kit when visualRequirement.required is true and pass the corresponding embedded-media case only with visualAdequacy=pass.
Reject V1 evidence in the V6 release path and V6 evidence in the V1 release path.
nonGoals: Activating PASSAGE or changing durable release selectors.
Changing learner runtime or application behavior.
Changing the meaning or bytes of historical V1, V2, V3, V4, or V6 contract authorities.
Adding web fetch, OCR, image generation, renderer services, or decorative-media requirements to the Factory gate.
independentReview: The repository PR scope gate independently proves that the candidate remains inside the exact work-package paths.
The dedicated exact-head workflow independently verifies immutable blob identities and the final pull-request head binding.
The semantic-review contract requires an independent context and explicit target digests before Factory PASS.
Qualified-release verification rebuilds the manifest from embedded exact bytes and rejects mixed implementation authorities.
Human promotion remains a later explicit decision after CI qualification; this candidate does not self-activate.
rollback: Delete or revert the candidate branch/PR. Main, OneDrive PASSAGE state, selectors, learner runtime, and previously published contract bytes remain unchanged.
